name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new role, workflow, standard, doc, or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

## Summary

A brief description of what you'd like added or changed.

## Type

- [ ] New role
- [ ] New workflow
- [ ] New standard
- [ ] Codex/root guidance
- [ ] New template
- [ ] Improvement to existing component
- [ ] Other:

## Problem / Motivation

What problem does this solve? What workflow does it improve?

## Proposed Solution

How do you think this should work? Include details like:
- For roles: what domain they own and what they should review
- For workflows: what the process looks like and what it should output
- For standards: what they should enforce and where they apply

## Alternatives Considered

Any other approaches you've thought about.

## Additional Context

Examples, references, or screenshots that help explain the request.
